date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R2-ME-012-D1: Commercial trade only. North Press January 24 and Shafaq January 25 reports differ on trade resumption, retained as January 24–25 bounds; December 15–16 onset bounds also remain. Kurdistan24 January 28 attributes restoration of previous passenger arrangements to a January 27 management announcement. This does not replace the earlier trade endpoint or prove unrestricted passenger access: Rudaw March 3 reports newlywed women still unable to reunite with husbands. Humanitarian and selected passenger exceptions prevent treating the entire interval as a total closure to all people. Exact first passenger passage and complete category-by-category restoration remain unknown.
